about_the_game:
Come find me...

Elemental Soul is a 2D side-scrolling roguelite focused on elemental-switching combat and endless item collection.

Three Elementals

In the world of ELEMENTAL SOUL, there are three primary elements —Fire, Arbor, and Water—and you have the mystical power to wield them.
If you wield the right element, you can gain the upper hand in battles against enemies.

And if it’s at precisely the right and opportune moment…

Weapons and Relics

As you explore, you’ll discover treasure chests containing one of the hundreds of unique weapons and relics (not hundreds yet, but soon!). You may carry up to three weapons at a time, while relics can be absorbed infinitely to grow ever stronger.
Uncover powerful synergies and forge your optimal build!

Story

Along your journey, you’ll make choices that determine your path. Your decisions affect stages, the unfolding narrative, the bosses you face, and even the townsfolk you meet.
An unexpected action today can trigger monumental changes tomorrow—so feel free to take your time and uncover the world’s secrets and hidden tales.

Key Features

  • Stylish 2D pixel art

  • Elemental action combat with a bit of Souls-like

  • Hundreds of weapons and relics

  • Branching storylines and choices

short_description: Born from the void, you are drawn beyond the ancient dungeon. Defeat your enemies and reclaim light, absorb relics and weapons of diverse powers as you proceed to the end. To unveil secrets, or to protect your friends, embark on a quest for your origin. Relentlessly.
